# Pixel Invoice Builder

A simple offline invoice builder built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Add line items with description, quantity, and unit price; view line totals, subtotal, tax, and grand total. All calculations update dynamically.

## Features

- Add line items with description, quantity, and unit price.
- Each line shows its total (quantity × unit price).
- Subtotal, tax (based on user-entered tax rate), and grand total displayed to two decimals.
- Remove items individually.
- Keyboard-accessible and responsive (works from 360px wide).
- No external dependencies, network requests, or server code.

## How to Run

1. Download or clone the repository.
2. Open `index.html` in any modern web browser.

No build step or server required.

## File Structure

- `index.html` — main markup and structure.
- `styles.css` — styling and theming.
- `script.js` — application logic and calculations.
- `README.md` — this file.

## Accessibility

- All form controls are labeled.
- Buttons have visible focus states.
- Table headers are properly scoped.
- Remove buttons include descriptive `aria-label`.

## Offline Usage

The app is fully self-contained and works offline. No external assets or network calls are made.
